data.name: Mabel
data.gender_notes: Mabel is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: My beautiful one; derived from the Old English ‘ma’ meaning ‘mother’ and ‘beal’ meaning ‘beautiful’. The name Mabel carries the meaning “My beautiful one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mabel usually hope their child will grow to embody my beautiful one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes beauty and motherly love
data.etymology: Mabel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “My beautiful one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mabel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: מאבל
in_hebrew.meaning: לא ניתן לתרגם משמעות שם זה לשפה העברית בקצרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם זה אינו מקורו בעברית או ביהדות אך משמש במסגרת השמות הנוצריים. מקור השם בלטינית ומשמעותו 'אהוב' או 'יקיר'. השם מאבל אינו מוזכר ישירות בתנ"ך אך הוא בעל משמעות רבה במסגרת השמות הנוצריים.

in_greek.name: Μαβελ
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα αυτό δεν έχει άμεση μετάφραση στα ελληνικά
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Mabel προέρχεται από το λατινικό Amabilis που σημαίνει 'αγαπητός' ή 'αξιαγάπητος'. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανικών ονομάτων, το Mabel μεταφέρει την έννοια του να είσαι αγαπημένος από τον Θεό. Δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα στα Ευαγγέλια ή στις Επιστολές.

in_latin.name: Mabel
in_latin.meaning: Amabilis, quae amorem et gratiam significat
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Mabel originem habet in Latino 'Amabilis', quod 'amore dignus' seu 'amabilis' significat. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc pietatem et devotionem ad Deum reflectit. Mabel saepe virtutem caritatis et humilitatis repraesentat.

in_english.name: Mabel
in_english.meaning: Lovely, dear one, or beloved in Christian contexts
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Mabel originates from the Latin 'Amabilis', meaning 'lovable' or 'beloved'. It conveys a sense of being dearly loved by God. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, Mabel has been used in Christian traditions to signify love, grace, and devotion. Historically, it was popularized in the Middle Ages. The name symbolizes spiritual beauty and kindness.

data.cultural_impact: Mabel is a classic and elegant English given name associated with a sense of beauty, grace, and elegance. Its usage can be traced back to the Middle Ages, and it has been popular in English-speaking countries ever since. Mabel has historical connections to notable poets such as Sir Thomas Wyatt, who wrote a poem titled "Mabel's Elegy," and is also referenced in the popular nursery rhyme "Mary Had a Little Lamb."
data.spiritual_significance: Mabel's name can be seen as a reflection of the beauty and nurturing nature of God. The old English 'ma' meaning 'mother' highlights the sacred bond between a mother and her child, and the name 'beal' meaning 'beautiful' celebrates the divine and aesthetic qualities present in all creation. Ultimately, Mabel's name serves as a reminder of the loving care and devotion of God towards his children, inspiring us to appreciate the beauty in ourselves and recognize the divine within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mabel, derived from the Hebrew name Amabel, means "mother of God," reflecting the deep reverence and devotion to the divine feminine in Christian spirituality. It evokes the image of Mary, the mother of Jesus, who nurtured and loved God incarnate.

biblical_reference.note: Though not directly mentioned in the Bible, its root 'Amabilis' reflects biblical themes of love and divine favor.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
